{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Compute median revenue
median_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].median()

# Compute quartiles and IQR
Q1 = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].quantile(0.25)
Q3 = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].quantile(0.75)
IQR = Q3 - Q1

# Compute bounds
lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR

# Identify outliers
outliers = completed_orders[(completed_orders['revenue_clean'] > upper_bound)]

# Print all required values
print("Mean revenue:", mean_revenue)
print("Median revenue:", median_revenue)
print("Q1:", Q1)
print("Q3:", Q3)
print("IQR:", IQR)
print("Upper bound:", upper_bound)
print("Number of outliers:", len(outliers))"}
